General Education Transfer Curriculum · CERTIFICATE OF ACHIEVEMENT
California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Certificate of Achievement
California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Certification
Cal-GETC General Education Certificate of Achievement requires 34 Units. Minimum GPA of 2.00 overall and a grade of “C” or better
in each course. Completion of Areas 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6;
AREA 1: English Communication 9 units (One from each group)
English C1000 English C1001 Communication C1000
AREA 2: Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning 3 units
Math 1A, 1B, 6, 24, Statistics C1000
AREA 3: Arts and Humanities 6 units – One from each group.
AREA 4: Social and Behavioral Sciences 6 units (two different academic areas).
AREA 5: Physical and Biological Sciences 7 units. At least 2 courses, one Physical Science and one Biological Science; at
least one must include a laboratory (indicated by “L” in parentheses).
AREA 6:  Ethnic Studies 3 units - At least 1 course.
Ethnic Studies 1
(Optional) Language other than English – proficiency equivalent to two years of high school study in the same language
(Optional) CSU Graduation Requirement in US HISTORY, Constitution and American Ideals 6 units
